blocks.orig: Pongwe Bay Resort lies directly on Pongwe Beach and offers suites, as well as a bungalow accommodating up to 9 people. They are beautifully appointed with handcrafted wooden furniture and a Swahili-inspired decor. They are equipped with mosquito nets, ensuite bathrooms, air-conditioning and garden, pool or ocean views. Some also have their own private patio or terrace with a seating area. The resort encourages its guests to go barefoot during their entire stay and reconnect with nature. Sandy paths through the lush tropical gardens lead to the a lovely swimming pool surrounded by sun beds. The private beach area is just a few steps further down – complimentary kayaks and stand-up paddles are provided. Sip your sundowners in the cocktail bar, enjoy a rejuvenating spa treatment and indulge in Swahili and Mediterranean cuisine in the 2 restaurants.
